description: Read the logged-in user's referral status: own referral code, sponsor, referral counts, bonus earned and remaining (SUN strings), rank, the referral list (PENDING/ACTIVE) and recent commission payouts. Use for referral questions only; account profile is `tronsave_get_user_info`. `offset`/`limit` page the referral list and the payout list together. Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only.

offset.description: Number of rows of each list to skip for pagination (default 0); add `limit` to page forward.

name: tronsave_get_referral
title: Referral Program
